# Value.VersionIdentity

```m
Value.VersionIdentity(value as any) as any
```

Returns the version identity of the `value`, or `null` if it doesn't have a version.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `any` | no |
